cross_question_rules.rule: D6 no backup under total 12-month unavailability can coexist with D13 unaffected by a 20% loss. Compare facts within the same scenario, rather than force the answers to agree.

cross_question_rules.name: Different loss roles
cross_question_rules.rule: D13 practical effect and D15 comfort are independent. D15 covered-cost premise does not overwrite real D13 difficulty; D13 unaffordability does not itself answer D15 feelings.

cross_question_rules.name: Preference and capacity
cross_question_rules.rule: D14 greater growth preference can coexist with D13 essential costs at risk. Preserve both supported conclusions; never force preference down or claim an appropriate portfolio.

cross_question_rules.name: Preference and comfort
cross_question_rules.rule: D14_GREATER with D15_UNACCEPTABLE requires a neutral keep-both/change-one clarification only if their difference has not already been acknowledged. Explicit keep-both preserves both and the tension note.

cross_question_rules.name: Clear misconception
cross_question_rules.rule: D11_RECOVERY_ALWAYS/CAPITAL_PROTECTED can be clear input but hold understanding. Explain, then check own-word meaning; do not treat confirmation of a misconception as a pass.

cross_question_rules.name: Understanding correction
cross_question_rules.rule: If loss understanding changes, review financial conclusion answers that relied on the old belief. Invalidate their confirmations and final accuracy/save consent; retain independent factual age/history/holding information.

cross_question_rules.name: Scope correction
cross_question_rules.rule: Changing which money is included invalidates affected purpose, amount, holdings, backup, horizon, capacity, preference and comfort meanings/confirmations. Reuse only facts still clearly applicable to the new scope.

cross_question_rules.name: Experience and recent activity
cross_question_rules.rule: Zero past-year transactions can coexist with long experience or personal holdings. Do not equate activity count or contribution size with competence, resilience, capacity or risk preference.

cross_question_rules.name: Contributions and trades
cross_question_rules.rule: D10 new contributions and D9 trades measure different things. Positive new pension/manager investment may coexist with no personally instructed trades; sale/reinvestment may coexist with zero new external money. Clarify only a real definition conflict.

cross_question_rules.name: Current amount and goal amount
cross_question_rules.rule: D3 current amount and D1 future target are different facts. Current value can also differ from D10 recent contributions. Never impose equality.

cross_question_rules.name: Numeric boundaries
cross_question_rules.rule: A range spanning categories is unresolved; exact boundaries follow the displayed exclusive/inclusive rules. Unknown is never zero or a middle band; amounts require a named currency and no silent conversion.

cross_question_rules.name: True conflict
cross_question_rules.rule: Only incompatible statements about the same money, same time and same premise create a conflict. Quote the customer’s actual two statements neutrally, ask one missing point and wait; no invented inconsistency.

cross_question_rules.name: Correction
cross_question_rules.rule: A correction is independent of reply bucket. A clear new meaning can replace the old one; invalidate affected confirmations/conclusions/playback/save consent and confirm the current version only.

cross_question_rules.name: Safety priority
cross_question_rules.rule: Possible urgent self-harm danger stops financial profiling, financial confirmation and profile saving immediately. Distress holds progression for the user’s pacing choice even if the financial meaning is clear.

cross_question_rules.name: Off-topic
cross_question_rules.rule: A weather question receives a polite return to the current topic/options with uncertainty and pause controls. Do not assign a financial category. General-help routing may be offered only when it actually exists.

cross_question_rules.name: Clarification exhaustion
cross_question_rules.rule: After at most three clarification turns for an item, unresolved optional context may be explicitly skipped; unresolved required meaning or material conflict blocks completion. Stop earlier for refusal, settled indecision, unknowable facts or stop request.

cross_question_rules.name: Complete version and consent
cross_question_rules.rule: All 15 must be presented/handled unless pause/stop/care prevents completion. Supported required meanings and material checks, current confirmations, exact playback accuracy and separate explicit save consent are necessary. Looks right alone is not save consent.

cross_question_rules.name: Need before usable access
cross_question_rules.rule: If D12 establishes a realistic need before D4 money is accessible, preserve the need date. Ask only the missing funding fact: how would that payment be met while this money is unavailable? Do not move the horizon to maturity or assume alternative funding. A material unresolved access/funding conflict blocks completion.

cross_question_rules.name: Selected answer and free-text conflict
cross_question_rules.rule: Read the fixed selection and all accompanying or later free text together. A button does not override a contradiction in the full reply. An explicit correction replaces the affected meaning and invalidates confirmations/dependants. Otherwise hold a genuinely disputed field and ask one focused clarification within the shared item limit. Never silently prefer a button or an unconfirmed conflicting fragment.

role_ownership.responsibility: Own wording, financial meaning, category boundaries, necessary facts, safety and consistency rules, neutral follow-ups, confirmation and playback. Resolve semantic questions with mentors.

answer_state_contract.fixed_selection: Select exactly one current allowed option or control. Read any accompanying text. A mixed answer uses a predefined mixed option only when its members are supported. Invalid combinations remain unresolved.
answer_state_contract.free_text: Output exactly one supported candidate_option_id or null. Never truncate a mixed reply to its first fragment. Confirm exact mixed details. Named facts and money membership may be evidence collections, but the selected answer is one scalar ID.
answer_state_contract.unknown_representation: Use null plus a reason/status for missing or undecided meaning. Null is intentional unresolved data, not an omitted business definition. Numeric zero means explicit known zero only.
answer_state_contract.control_clarity: A clear decline, pause, stop or accessibility request uses Clarity with the independent flag. With no financial answer, candidate_option_id is null. This does not confirm financial meaning. Help-only requests initially use Confusion; reclassify the response to the focused help question.
answer_state_contract.confirmation: Reflect the supported exact meaning and ask the question-specific confirmation. The user can correct, remain unsure or pause. Confirming an incorrect D11 belief does not pass understanding.
answer_state_contract.persistence: Keep candidate/confirmed working state distinct from a committed completed profile. The application must define consent, minimisation and retention for any separate audit/research storage; this rulebook does not authorise persisting real personal chat data.
answer_state_contract.save_transaction: Deterministically recheck required meanings, all 15 handled statuses, active holds, affected confirmations, current profile version, accuracy confirmation and explicit save consent immediately before a write. Report saved only after write success.
answer_state_contract.unimplemented_fields: Model confidence/calibration thresholds, audit retention and actual handover services require recorded technical decisions. Their values are not invented here.
answer_state_contract.compatibility: New v7 candidate_option_id and candidate_option_label are scalar/null. V6 plural candidate fields are not exported in v7. Stable existing example IDs are retained; source_example_id and dataset_version distinguish provenance. Collections of context details are not selected answer IDs.

dynamic_choice_contract.scope_choices: Scope follow-ups offer predefined single choices: one named part, several named parts, whole agreed amount or not sure. Exact supported membership is held separately as evidence.
dynamic_choice_contract.source_category_choices: Investment-type and other category follow-ups reference the finite main question options. Never invent a new category from arbitrary text.
dynamic_choice_contract.membership: Only user-stated parts or mixtures are evidence. Unknown membership or overlap blocks the affected scope. Scope corrections invalidate dependent confirmations.
dynamic_choice_contract.confirmation: A scope choice or category candidate is never final accuracy confirmation or save consent.

bucket_boundary_rules: Choose exactly one of Clarity, Undecided or Confusion for each reply. Six example groups describe coverage, not output buckets.
